hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Filter for email addresses ending in .com and extract the domain after the @ symbol.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Use string functions to isolate the domain substring and group by that domain to count occurrences.

hints.title: Query Structure
hints.text: Filter using like %.com, extract with substring index, and sort by email domain ascending.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(email, '@', -1) AS email_domain,
    COUNT(*) AS count
FROM Emails
WHERE email LIKE '%.com'
GROUP BY email_domain
ORDER BY email_domain ASC;
```

complexity.notes: Linear string parsing followed by aggregation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Failing to filter on .com includes invalid domain extensions.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Accurate substring extraction and aggregation on extracted domain.

solutions.code:
SELECT
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(email, '@', -1) AS email_domain,
    COUNT(*) AS count
FROM Emails
WHERE email LIKE '%.com'
GROUP BY email_domain
ORDER BY email_domain ASC;

SELECT
    SPLIT_PART(email, '@', 2) AS email_domain,
    COUNT(*) AS count
FROM Emails
WHERE email LIKE '%.com'
GROUP BY email_domain
ORDER BY email_domain ASC;
